frames.pose: Ready. The working mitten wraps the same short shaft at twenty degrees above horizontal.
Anticipation. Raise the same wrist and bend the elbow. The perpendicular T tilts with the shaft.
High pose. Right elbow and wrist bring the head near the goggles. Left mitten stays down.
Fast downswing on the same arc. A narrow steel smear trails the intact hammer still held by its shaft.
Impact hold. The shaft runs horizontally out of the same fist and the lower striking face lands flat on the coin.
Rebound a short distance up the same arc. The shaft center still crosses the same closed fist.
Return to the opening drawing and angle.
Hold the opening drawing before the next strike.
